name: Tsumi Guiltia
source:
An angel girl carries our "sin" and gets attacked dropping the carriage. What is the identity of "Guiltia"? Is it our libido sacrifice? Hop in to find the answer.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一位天使女孩背负着我们的“罪孽”，遭到袭击，摔下了马车。“罪孽”的身份是什么？这是我们的性欲牺牲吗？跳进去寻找答案。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-april-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
